node.statement: Validation-gated bridge from node 1.5: once node 1.5 is validated, it states for every pair P,Q in calU that mu(P,Q)=u_delta(P bold-dot Q) is defined, belongs to calU, and satisfies ||mu(P,Q)-P bold-dot Q||<=84*epsilon_r. Instantiate first with (P,Q)=(U,V) and (V,W) to obtain A=mu(U,V) in calU and B=mu(V,W) in calU. Then instantiate with (P,Q)=(A,W) and (U,B), which is legitimate because A,B,U,W are in calU, to get ||mu(A,W)-A bold-dot W||<=84*epsilon_r and ||mu(U,B)-U bold-dot B||<=84*epsilon_r. Symmetry of the norm rewrites the latter as ||U bold-dot B-mu(U,B)||<=84*epsilon_r, exactly the two estimates asserted by node 1.6.1.
